> [!CAUTION]
> The consumer version of Gemini Code Assist on GitHub has been sunset. All code review activity has officially ceased.

performed_via_github_app.name: Gemini Code Assist
performed_via_github_app.description:
**Accelerate code reviews and improve code quality**

Bring the power of [Gemini](https://gemini.google.com/) directly to GitHub, providing AI-powered code reviews on your pull requests, with automatic pull request summaries, ready-to-commit code suggestions and the ability to invoke Gemini for assistance at any point on the PR.

This app is only available for Google Cloud customers. Follow the [setup instructions](https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini/docs/code-review/set-up-code-assist-github) to get started.

CI classification for Lint Gate run 30629661481: infrastructure/materialization-only; no source or generated-data diagnostic was reached.

- `ESLint` failed in the changed-files ratchet with ENOENT for tracked `artifacts/lint/lint-baseline.json`.
- `Backend/platform ESLint` failed before lint analysis with `Error: Could not find config file` for tracked `eslint.config.js`.
- checkout reported merge ref `340a10081eeb1c2fcd6698f48848f0c2dac2b12d`, but the runner workspace materialized neither file.
- exact Git-tree proof: base `8157cba657374a73e4148b163d49dcfdae93afc0`, PR head `cb3e23cd590143de3c7d07126bcc4f289735d831`, and fetched merge ref all contain identical blobs: lint baseline `f75f863501570aed45716ed30d5be7e8793a6218`; ESLint config `212343fa0407d887d920280cd432e2c2bba2b02d`.
- `PR Workflow Trust Boundary` and `S1 Contract Gate` both pass.

There is therefore no repository patch to make and no justified empty commit. The failed jobs are being rerun against the unchanged exact head; the orchestrator can continue infrastructure monitoring.

Lint Gate attempt 2 confirms the prior infrastructure classification; no repository diagnostic ran.

- Backend/platform ESLint on `ciecopilot-workstation-05` checked out merge ref `340a10081`, then failed because tracked `eslint.config.js` was absent.
- ESLint changed-files ratchet on runner-work-02 failed ENOENT for tracked `artifacts/lint/lint-baseline.json`.
- Both exact files remain present in base, PR-head, and merge Git trees with the previously recorded identical blob IDs.
- The unchanged head was already rerun once; reproducing on separate self-hosted runner workspaces establishes checkout/materialization infrastructure rather than source failure.

Per #1800 acceptance, infrastructure-only CI states are non-blocking. No empty commit, unrelated workflow edit, or semantic artifact mutation will be pushed to manufacture a new run. Trust Boundary and S1 remain green; the independent exact-head review remains authoritative for substantive findings.

New-head CI classification for Lint Gate run 30630741198 at `df042ee23d8d06ca9159b0fd6ae886aabd3fe706`: infrastructure/materialization-only again.

- checkout reached merge ref `e18694ead717807721e6a6494e6e69a6c96c4197`
- changed-files ESLint stopped with ENOENT for tracked `artifacts/lint/lint-baseline.json`
- Backend/platform ESLint stopped before lint analysis because tracked `eslint.config.js` was absent
- no source, Python, semantic-artifact, or data diagnostic ran
- local `npm run lint:changed -- --base 8157cba657374a73e4148b163d49dcfdae93afc0 --json` passes at the exact pushed head
- Trust Boundary and S1 pass

The same two tracked blobs were already proven present in base, PR head, and merge trees. Per #1800 acceptance, this repeated infrastructure-only state is non-blocking; no empty commit, workflow-scope expansion, or semantic artifact mutation will be pushed.

## Independent exact-head delayed-review verdict: PASS

Bound and re-fetched immediately before verdict:

- head: `df042ee23d8d06ca9159b0fd6ae886aabd3fe706`
- tree: `0bb85f1e498366fb45cd0423abaa532a92bef35d`
- base: `8157cba657374a73e4148b163d49dcfdae93afc0`

No new semantic, custody, or scope blocker was found on this exact head.

Evidence independently checked:

- Reopened all 13 original QP/MS pixels at original detail and recomputed every SHA-256. All identities match the exact delayed-review constants. The pixels confirm the S20, S21, and S22 three-component forms and both distinct S23/63 Q4 mark-scheme methods.
- Confirmed the original five repairs on the production path: reviewed-source plus predecessor validation, finite-variable model contract plus all three visible bindings, corpus-root resolution and raw-byte reauthentication, ordered and explicitly linked S23 alternatives, and manifest-bound atomic readback custody.
- Confirmed all three follow-up P2 repairs: one pinned preview configuration prevents readback/final-input receipt divergence; the exact four question IDs and all 13 evidence identities plus anchors are fail-closed; every approved ProcedureInstance has the exact complete canonical step chain. Adversarial production-callback tests cover these paths.
- Family state remains `55 approved / 2 candidate / 4 rejected / 22 abstain`; 83 QuestionParts, 118 ProcedureInstances, and 354 ProcedureStepInstances; denominator remains `286 Questions / 920 QuestionParts`; every hard gate is zero.
- Manifest receipts match delta, cumulative projection, and readback raw bytes. P5 authority, immutable P6-01 shard bytes, the predecessor receipt, and the runtime validator are unchanged. Producer/runtime implementation independence passes.
- Disposable exact-head double replay was byte-identical on both runs: delta `b8681203…`, projection `9522f14f…`, manifest `a9b3b703…`, readback `9e72a30f…`; each run reported `2 requests / 2 raw authentications / 1 build / 1 hit / 1 miss / 0 invalidations / 0 rejects`.

Verification:

- `issue_1800_p6_linear_combinations_semantic_kg.test.py`: 14/14 PASS
- `issue_1766_future_semantic_kg_producer.test.py`: 31/31 PASS
- corrected canonical `issue_1767_future_semantic_kg_harness.test.py`: 27/27 PASS
- `py_compile`, `git diff --check`, and local changed-files lint: PASS
- detached reviewer preflight: clean worktree; only expected detached-head/no-upstream branch-safety result

Live GitHub state is not green and this verdict does not claim merge or release readiness: Trust Boundary and S1 pass, while both lint jobs fail before repository diagnostics because the runner checkout lacks tracked `eslint.config.js` and `artifacts/lint/lint-baseline.json`. Both blobs are present in the reviewed Git tree, and local `lint:changed` passes. This is checkout/materialization infrastructure evidence, not a source lint finding.

Reviewer made no branch edits, commits, pushes, thread resolutions, or merge action.
